nodes.title: 《希望的原理》(Das Prinzip Hoffnung, 1954-59) ⭐
nodes.summary: This partial document provides information about Ernst Bloch's magnum opus "Das Prinzip Hoffnung" (The Principle of Hope), a three-volume work published between 1954 and 1959. The document highlights the concept of "ontology of the not-yet" associated with the work. It lists various versions and sources for accessing the text, including a Chinese translation by Menghai published by Shanghai Translation in 2012, an English introduction available on marxists.org, a three-volume English translation available for borrowing on Archive.org, and a German academic edition accessible as a PDF on Archive.org through the De Gruyter platform.

nodes.title: 获取策略
nodes.summary:
## 获取策略

布洛赫中文资源远不如卢卡奇丰富：
- 《希望的原理》→ **微信读书**最方便
- 《乌托邦的精神》→ 只有英/德文，Archive.org
- 《主体-客体》→ 2024新出中译，Z-Library 搜
